Novartis reports in USD; converted exactly from USD millions. LEADER: Vasant Narasimhan (CEO) held 312,846 vested shares and ADRs at December 31, 2025, plus 72,382 unvested shares and other equity rights and 232,965 unvested PSUs (total 618,193). shares records the vested figure only. The 20-F says no Executive Committee member owned 1% or more, and gives no percentage, so pctEconomic is null. HOLDERS: UBS Group AG's and BlackRock's 7.3% come from the 7.A table, 'calculated on the basis of 1 908 151 679 ordinary shares outstanding', i.e. excluding treasury shares; both rest on Schedule 13G filings (UBS AM, July 17, 2025; BlackRock, February 2, 2024), whose event dates the 20-F does not give, so asOf is null. UBS Fund Management (Switzerland) AG's registered 5.5% of share capital is part of the UBS group and is not listed separately. Norges Bank's 2.2% is of share capital including treasury shares (a different base), from a disclosure notification. Emasan AG (beneficial owner Sandoz - Fondation de Famille) is registered with 2.0% of share capital, below Norges Bank, and is not listed. Nominees (Nortrust 3.7%, Bank of New York Mellon 4.6%) and the ADS depositary JPMorgan (8.0%) are custodians, not beneficial owners. BUYBACKS: USD 9,212 million 'Purchases of treasury shares' (cash flow). The 20-F says the 77.6 million shares bought in 2025 for USD 8.9 billion included 49.1 million (USD 5.4 billion) under the USD 15 billion buyback completed in July 2025, 17.8 million (USD 2.3 billion) under the new up-to USD 10 billion buyback announced in July 2025, and 10.7 million (USD 1.3 billion) to mitigate dilution from employee equity plans; the full cash-flow figure is kept. DIVIDENDS: USD 7,818 million to shareholders of Novartis AG. STOCK COMP: USD 1,330 million 'Expense related to equity-based participation plans' (continuing operations). GEOGRAPHY: net sales only (USD 54,532 million); other revenues (USD 2,142 million) are not included.
